RPG Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 – Gødstrup is a psychiatric organization operating within Region Midtjylland (Central Denmark Region). It is highlighted in the 2024 annual ADHD database report for its strong performance on a newly expanded clinical quality metric [^src1].

In 2024, the national ADHD database introduced [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] to evaluate the quality of pharmacological treatment among adults with ADHD, expanding the database's scope which previously only covered children and adolescents [^src1]. RPG Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 – Gødstrup achieved a result of 82% (based on 201 out of 246 patients, with a confidence interval of 76-86%) for this indicator [^src1]. This very high result is significant because it directly supports Region Midtjylland's position as the region with the second-highest nationwide result for this specific quality metric [^src1].
